s2.ptxt: Using a flat-tip screwdriver, compress the drive shaft bearing bracket hole snap ring and remove it from the bearing bracket.
Remove bearing bracket bolt No.1 and remove the front drive shaft assembly RH from the drive shaft bearing bracket.

item.ptxt: Do not damage the oil seal.
Do not drop the drive shaft assembly.
When removing/installing the drive shaft assembly RH, drain all the transaxle oil and transfer oil.

If the drive shaft assembly RH is removed/installed without draining the oil, transfer oil will flow into the transaxle side. As the transaxle and transfer use different oils, the 2 types of oil will mix, and internal cleaning of the transaxle and transfer will be necessary.
